"use client";

import { Grid, GridItem } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { DecorativeBox } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/chakra/upstream/lib/decorative-box"

export const GridSpanningColumns = () => {
  return (
    <Grid
      h="200px"
      templateRows="repeat(2, 1fr)"
      templateColumns="repeat(5, 1fr)"
      gap={4}
    >
      <GridItem rowSpan={2} colSpan={1}>
        <DecorativeBox>rowSpan=2</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem colSpan={2}>
        <DecorativeBox>colSpan=2</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem colSpan={2}>
        <DecorativeBox>colSpan=2</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem colSpan={4}>
        <DecorativeBox>colSpan=4</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
    </Grid>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Grid, GridItem } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { DecorativeBox } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/chakra/upstream/lib/decorative-box"

export const GridWithTemplateAreas = () => {
  return (
    <Grid
      gap="4"
      templateAreas={`
      "one one two three"
      "four five five three"
    `}
    >
      <GridItem bg="green.500" area="one">
        <DecorativeBox minH="20">one</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem bg="pink.500" area="two">
        <DecorativeBox minH="20">two</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem bg="red.500" area="three">
        <DecorativeBox minH="20">three</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem bg="teal.500" area="four">
        <DecorativeBox minH="20">four</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
      <GridItem bg="yellow.500" area="five">
        <DecorativeBox minH="20">five</DecorativeBox>
      </GridItem>
    </Grid>
  )
}

# Chakra UI Grid

Arrange and align interface content.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
